comparisons.peer_topic: AI Software Ecosystem and Silo AI Acquisition
comparisons.peer_summary: To support its AI strategy, AMD consolidated AI teams to develop a comprehensive software ecosystem, improved AMD ROCm software performance, and acquired Silo AI Oy to accelerate AI model development and deployment on AMD hardware, leveraging Silo's software stack for training large language models.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies disclose strategic advancements in AI software ecosystems to support hardware adoption. NVIDIA highlights specific AI tools for the gaming sector, such as 'NVIDIA Avatar Cloud Engine for Games' and 'DLSS 3.5 Ray Reconstruction,' focusing on consumer-facing AI features. In contrast, AMD’s comparable disclosure focuses on backend infrastructure and developer tools, detailing the consolidation of AI teams to build a 'comprehensive software ecosystem' and the acquisition of Silo AI to 'accelerate development and deployment of AI models on AMD hardware' using its ROCm software. While both address AI software strategy, NVIDIA's focus is on gaming-specific generative and graphics AI, whereas AMD's is on enterprise-grade model training and deployment infrastructure.

sentences.text: We announced NVIDIA Avatar Cloud Engine for Games, a custom AI model foundry service using AI-powered natural language interactions to transform games and launched DLSS 3.5 Ray Reconstruction.
To execute our AI strategy, we brought together multiple AI teams across AMD to drive development of a comprehensive software ecosystem spanning our full product portfolio.
The acquisition of Silo AI enables customers to accelerate development and deployment of AI models on AMD hardware.
